About Quantum Calibration Explorer

A cutting-edge visualization platform for quantum computing researchers, combining stunning graphics with powerful analysis tools.

Our Mission

We bridge the gap between raw calibration data and actionable insights for quantum computing researchers. By providing intuitive visualizations and automated analysis, we help accelerate qubit tune-up workflows and improve gate fidelities across superconducting quantum processors.

Calibration Evolution

1950s

NMR Discovery

Purcell and Bloch independently discover nuclear magnetic resonance, laying the foundation for quantum control.

1980s

First Qubit Experiments

Ion traps and superconducting circuits emerge as viable qubit platforms with coherent control.

1995

Rabi Oscillations Observed

First clear observation of coherent Rabi oscillations in trapped ions, demonstrating precise pulse control.

2007

Transmon Qubit Invented

Koch et al. introduce the transmon design, dramatically improving coherence times and enabling scalable architectures.

2019

Quantum Supremacy

Google demonstrates quantum supremacy with a 53-qubit processor, marking a milestone in quantum computing.

Present

Cloud Calibration

AI-powered calibration platforms enable remote qubit tuning and automated error diagnosis for quantum researchers worldwide.
